capabilities: Sync meeting notes, summaries, and transcripts from Granola into the vault
Customize note output with template variables and conditional blocks
Link attendees to existing Person notes by email
Download meeting screenshots and photos into an attachments folder
Connect and sync multiple Granola accounts with deduplication
extras: Desktop-only (needs Node.js APIs). The optional API key is stored unencrypted in the vault, and its features (end time, duration, transcript-based timing) require a Granola Business or Enterprise plan.
intentEvidence: There are other (1, 2) Granola plugins for Obsidian, but I found their implementation lacking for my needs.
motivation: The author found existing Granola plugins too complex or missing private notes, attendee linking, and template customization, so wrote one fitting their workflow.
problem: Granola holds meeting notes and transcripts in its own app, so Obsidian users must copy that content manually to keep it in their vault.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses Granola's official MCP API to sync meeting notes, AI summaries, and transcripts

requires.name: Granola API key (grn_...) for end time and duration
Granola Business or Enterprise plan (API key features)

summary: Syncs Granola meeting notes, AI summaries, transcripts, and images into your vault via the official MCP API, with template-based output.
